title: Visual Stereotypes of Autism Spectrum in Janus-Pro-7B, DALL-E, Stable Diffusion, SDXL, FLUX, and Midjourney

bias_targets.methodology: Generating images using neutral prompts related to autism and comparing them against control prompts (neurotypicality), followed by expert assessment using a 10-point deductive coding framework to measure visual stereotypes (e.g., puzzle symbols, isolation, emotional blandness, nerdy traits).

Coding generated images to calculate the proportion of male versus female characters depicted in autism-related prompts, evaluating the stereotypical overrepresentation of males on the autism spectrum.
Assessing the racial presentation of individuals in images generated from autism-related prompts to measure the stereotypical overrepresentation of white individuals.
Evaluating the apparent age of individuals depicted in the generated images to detect the stereotype that autism primarily affects children.
